fix_2_fix_3.name: Crawl budget (Fix 2) / program-gate cross-sell pollution (Fix 3)
fix_2_fix_3.note: Real evidence gathered against a live 8-target SMU batch on onlinemanipal.com: current MAX_PAGES_FETCHED=40 resolves 5/8 real targets; 3 sit ~600 positions deep in the sitemap (nav links alone already exceed the budget); reaching them would cost ~200s, breaching the <=60s/10-target goal. A larger budget was also found to surface a genuine real duplicate-content case correctly resolved as ambiguous_candidates, not a wrong pick. Paused before a bounded value was chosen -- user redirected to Sprint 6 (product-priority refinement) instead. Fix 3 was not investigated as deeply as Fix 2.

sprint_6.name: Priority Fact Comparison & Explainable Reporting
sprint_6.objective: Sprint 5B answers which authoritative page to compare against; Sprint 6 answers what exactly changed between the authoritative page and the target. New, additive priorityComparison field on TargetRunResult; frontend renders it directly, computes nothing.
approved_decisions: Legacy comparison view (Sprint 4/4b) kept exactly as-is, fully additive, no retirement
Accreditation/Rankings & Accreditations use the simple summary-string representation (comma-joined list-diff), not a richer nested per-item structure
New 7-value PriorityFieldStatus lives as its own parallel type, never a change to the existing 6-value ComparisonStatus

phases.phase_2_backend: done -- new types, buildPriorityComparison, new extraction (fee/accreditation/ranking/others), wired into buildMasterPageIndex.ts/discoverAndCompareMany.ts, zero new fetches, +35 tests
phases.phase_3_frontend: done -- PriorityComparisonHeader/Table/Unavailable/ChangesSummary, additive to TargetDetailPage.tsx/TargetTable.tsx, legacy ComparisonTable untouched, +22 tests
phases.phase_4_full_validation: substantively folded into Phase 3's own final validation pass (full workspace suite + live 8-target SMU batch through the real API) rather than run as a formally separate fourth phase

sprint_6.tests: 470/470 passing (211 packages/core [+25], 158 modules/website-quality [+10], 17 apps/api [unchanged], 84 apps/dashboard [+22]), zero regressions in the prior 413
sprint_6.performance: ~18.5s end-to-end (real HTTP API) for an 8-target batch; master crawl itself unchanged from the pre-Sprint-6 baseline (~15-17s), zero added network overhead. One perf regression caught and fixed during Phase 2: multi-match label extraction was recompiling a regex per block x label instead of once per label, adding ~5s to a 40-candidate crawl -- fixed by hoisting compilation out of the loop.
sprint_6.live_validation: Two real batches against onlinemanipal.com through the real running API: an 8-target self-discovered SMU set used during Phase 2 performance work, and the user-specified 8-target ln-*-smu batch (MBA, MCA, M.Com, BA, MA Political Science, MA Sociology, MA English, B.Com) used for final Phase 3 validation -- 3 successful / 3 ambiguous / 2 not-found, a genuinely mixed real outcome set proving all three UI paths (success table, ambiguous panel, not-found panel).
sprint_6.browser_tooling_note: Chrome extension was not connected during the Phase 3 automated validation pass -- substituted real-API-plus-rendered-DOM verification; the user then performed their own manual visual review of the running dev servers directly and approved it.
sprint_6.scope_narrowing_approved_not_a_gap: Only one fee priority field (semesterFee) built, not all 8 fee sub-types the product requirement originally described; ranking rank/year parsing is unstructured free-text extraction (most speculative part of this sprint); Others fields use exact-text comparison, no fuzzy/semantic matching (no LLM anywhere in this project).

known_issues: ln-pgcp-ei-mahe (one specific real URL) redirects (302) to the Master's bare homepage -- no reliable evidence exists there to resolve a specific program; correctly stays authoritative_page_not_found, investigated and documented, not fixed (not a resolution-logic defect -- a stale-URL/content problem on the real site).

Program Relevance Gate subject-overlap can still false-positive-tie across genuinely different subjects on the real Online Manipal site -- safe (ambiguous_candidates, never a wrong pick), same family as C5/Fix 3, not fixed.
PG-Certificate-style program naming (ln-pgcp-*) not recognized by degree-keywords.json -- an Understanding-layer (Sprint 2) gap.

Sprint 2 fact-extraction gaps confirmed still present on real pages, reconfirmed again during Sprint 6 live validation: duration/mode/accreditation are frequently both_missing, and eligibility/fees occasionally capture a table-header label instead of the actual value (e.g. 'Full Fee Payment', 'Educational qualification') on real Online Manipal pages. Sprint 6's new fee-safety logic correctly downgrades this to needs_review rather than fabricating a result, but the underlying extraction gap itself is unchanged, pre-existing, unrelated to Sprint 6.

Institution vs. brand conflation (Sprint 2) is mitigated for REGISTERED institutions by Sprint 3's brand-alias fallback in resolveSource. Unregistered institutions still correctly report no_registry_entry, not a guess.

Heading-scoped claim extraction can grab a short label instead of the full sentence on real pages with nested sub-headings. Unrelated to Sprint 3/4/4b/5/5B/D1/frontend/Sprint 6; still open, best-effort per Sprint 2's stated scope.

C5 (Sprint 5/5B, acknowledged, not fixed): real-world recall limitation on large, non-university-shaped sites -- system still never guesses wrong. Directly related to the paused Fix 2 crawl-budget investigation (real evidence gathered this session: 3 of 8 real SMU targets sit ~600 positions deep in the sitemap, unreachable within the performance budget).

A residual D1-adjacent gap remains, by design, for a target whose ONLY institution/brand signal (across URL, page text, and logo) is the generic shared brand identical to the wrong institution's own signal -- text/logo-based corroboration cannot distinguish that narrow case; closing it fully needs full MAHE/SMU Source registration or deeper extraction, both still open decisions.

apps/dashboard's dependency tree carries a known, dev-server-only esbuild advisory inherent to the Vite 5.x line vitest@2.1.4 requires -- a deliberate, documented trade-off (ADR-011), not a production risk.
apps/api's RunStore is in-memory only -- lost on process restart, no run history/list view yet. Explicit Phase 1 scope, isolated behind an interface for a later persistent implementation.

Sprint 6's own deliberately-narrowed scope (one fee priority field, unstructured ranking parsing, exact-text Others comparison) -- approved scoping choices, not defects, see sprint_6.scope_narrowing_approved_not_a_gap above.

Memory-file staleness has recurred multiple times across sessions, again this session (Fix 1 was committed in a prior session with zero memory updates; an old provisional 'Sprint 6' label collided with this session's actual Sprint 6, now renumbered to Sprint 7) -- always caught by cross-checking git log/git status/source directly rather than trusting memory at face value. Continue doing that at the start of every session.
